newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices -March 26.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices -March 26.

text.p: (DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker market on Wednesday edged up marginally, riding on cargo strength, traders said. They said the higher cargo prices have spurred some shipowners who need to cover their requirements to raise their bids to meet offers. But total volumes transacted were heard to be less than average as some buyers were still holding back for lower prices.
